name: Level_2 - Task_8
description: Train a Ridge regression model using Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) descriptors to predict the MACE potential energy of perturbed Silicon structures. Start with a conventional cubic unit cell of diamond Silicon using a lattice parameter of a = 5.43 Å and expand it into a 2 × 2 × 2 supercell. Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model from the local path ./models/2023-12-03-mace-128-L1_epoch-199.model as an ASE-compatible calculator. Generate a dataset of 100 perturbed configurations. For each configuration i, where i ranges from 0 to 99, copy the base supercell and apply random atomic displacements drawn from a normal distribution with a standard deviation of 0.01 + 0.001 × i Å. Evaluate the total potential energy of each configuration using the MACE calculator. Compute SOAP descriptors for all 100 configurations using the dscribe library with species=['Si'], r_cut=5.0 Å, n_max=6, l_max=6, periodic=True via DSCRIBE api, and average='inner', using n_jobs=1. Use configurations 0–79 as the training set and configurations 80–99 as the held-out test set. Train a Ridge regression model with Scikit-learn api with alpha=1e-3 using the SOAP descriptors and corresponding MACE potential energies. Save the trained Ridge regression model in pickle format and return the absolute path to the saved model's pickle file.
submission_format: string representing the absolute path to the output file (eg. '/path/to/trained_model.pkl')
